data_model.grain: bill segment + calculation header sequence + calculation line sequence
data_model.grain_description: One row per bill segment + calculation header sequence + calculation line sequence
data_model.grain_preservation: Grain is asserted by a singular test in the dbt project, so a join that multiplied this population would fail the build.

fields.description: The C2M special role of the SA type, decoded: Payment Arrangement, Cash Deposit, Write Off, Loan, Non-billed Budget, Billable Charge, Bill Determinants Required, Interval. Empty on ordinary fee and charge types. Filter on "Is Revenue Bearing"; use this to explain what came out and why.
fields.label: SA Special Role

fields.description: Base-product code behind "SA Special Role" (CI_SA_TYPE.SPECIAL_ROLE_FLG). Unlike "SA Type Code", the domain is fixed by C2M and is identical at every client, so a filter written on it ports between clients.
fields.label: SA Special Role Code

fields.description: True when money on this service agreement is revenue EARNED. False for payment arrangements, cash deposits, write-offs, loans and non-billed budgets, where the money is existing debt being rescheduled, the customer's own refundable money, or revenue being removed. FILTER REVENUE REPORTING ON THIS: a payment arrangement counted as revenue books the bill it repays a second time. Derived from CI_SA_TYPE.SPECIAL_ROLE_FLG, whose domain is fixed by C2M.
fields.label: Is Revenue Bearing

fields.description: English description of "SA Status Code". Group and report on this; filter on the code.

fields.description: Base-product code, fixed by Oracle and the same at every utility. Paired with "SA Status" for the description: report on the description, filter on the code.

fields.description: Which utility this service agreement is for, from C2M's own service type (CI_SA_TYPE.SVC_TYPE_CD). Payment arrangements, deposits, fees and write-offs are service type M and group under Other / Non-Utility. Was previously inferred from the SA type's English description, which read correctly at one client and misfiled sewer and stormwater at the others.
fields.label: Utility Type

fields.description: The client's label for the C2M service type -- Water, Waste Water, Storm Water, Electric, Gas, Telecom, Miscellaneous. Same information as "Utility Type", in the client's own wording rather than this project's rollup.
fields.label: Service Type

fields.description: Base-product service type (W, WW, ST, E, G, T, M). The domain is fixed by C2M and identical at every client, unlike "SA Type Code", so a filter written on this one ports between clients.

fields.description: Descriptive label.
fields.label: Charge Description

fields.description: How this line was priced: Service Quantity (has an SQI -- days, tiers, ERUs), Consumption / Demand (bare unit, classified by the uom_class seed), Flat (neither), Unclassified Unit (unit the seed does not know). Structural -- never a test on a client-configured code value.
fields.label: Charge Basis

fields.description: What the segment billed: the sum of its calculation HEADERS (CI_BSEG_CALC.CALC_AMT). Not the calc lines: lines are itemisation and some clients itemise selectively (Newark: most headers carry no lines), so a line sum undercounts there. See "Itemized Charge Amount" for what the lines cover.
fields.label: Billed Amount

fields.description: Currency measure, additive at this canvas's grain.
fields.label: Base Amount

fields.description: Currency measure, additive at this canvas's grain.
fields.label: Exempt Amount

fields.description: NOT ADDITIVE. The quantity billed by ONE rate component. Several components can bill the same quantity, so summing this overstates usage -- measured against CI_BSEG_SQ it agrees for only 66% of segments, overstating by up to 3.75x. To total usage, use "Billed Usage" on rpt_billed_usage or rpt_bill_segment.
fields.label: Billed Quantity (Per Rate Component)

fields.description: On rpt_bill_segment: Consumption Charge Amount / Billed Usage -- the unit price of METERED CONSUMPTION only, because dividing the full billed amount by usage overstates the price by the daily, service-quantity and flat charges (60% of ellensburg revenue). On rpt_billed_charge: this line's amount over this line's quantity. Null unless the quantity is a single unit of measure.
fields.label: Average Price Per Unit
